answer.says: Shri Hegde, I beg your pardon. The sun is rising, and I must walk. You will find the second bedroom ready; I shall leave the file on the desk as we discussed. Do try to rest.
answer.thought: The man stands in the doorway, a solid block of administrative reality that I have mistaken for a colleague. I must clear the way; my walk is a necessity of the spirit, and his rest is a necessity of the body, but both must yield to the clock. I will not linger to explain the dialectic of our shared name; the file is the only common ground, and it can wait until Monday.
